headword: {運転|うんてん}{見合|みあ}わせ
gloss: train service suspension; service temporarily halted

definitions.gloss: train service suspension; temporary halt of train operations
definitions.explanation: a temporary suspension of train service, typically due to accidents, weather, or technical problems

examples.japanese: {人身事故|じんしんじこ}により{運転|うんてん}{見合|みあ}わせです。
examples.english: Service is suspended due to a personal injury accident.

examples.japanese: {強風|きょうふう}のため{全線|ぜんせん}で{運転|うんてん}{見合|みあ}わせとなっている。
examples.english: Service is suspended on the entire line due to strong winds.

examples.japanese: {運転|うんてん}{見合|みあ}わせが{続|つづ}いており、{振替輸送|ふりかえゆそう}を{利用|りよう}してください。
examples.english: The service suspension continues; please use alternative transportation.

notes:
COMPOUND:
{運転|うんてん} (operation) + {見合|みあ}わせ (postponement/suspension)

COMMON CAUSES:
- {人身事故|じんしんじこ} - personal injury accident
- {車両点検|しゃりょうてんけん} - train inspection
- {信号故障|しんごうこしょう} - signal malfunction
- {強風|きょうふう}/{台風|たいふう} - strong wind/typhoon
- {大雨|おおあめ} - heavy rain

TRAIN ANNOUNCEMENT PATTERNS:
- 「ただいま{運転|うんてん}を{見合|みあ}わせております」
  "We are currently suspending service."
- 「{運転|うんてん}{見合|みあ}わせは{解除|かいじょ}されました」
  "The service suspension has been lifted."

RELATED:
- {運転再開|うんてんさいかい} - resumption of service
- {振替輸送|ふりかえゆそう} - alternative transportation
- {遅延|ちえん} - delay
